consumed_by: music_studio/planner.py (mood_orbit vector -> deterministic prose clause; architecture s3.2)
provenance_rule: pole phrases use the measured register (plain concrete words, direct action verbs); intensity tiers follow the Lyria prompt guide's own graded-language pattern (archived guide, timestamp/intensity prompting section, read 2026-08-14). Identical coordinates always produce an identical clause; the clause is returned in bindings.mood_orbit.sent.
combination_rule: take the two highest-valued poles; each renders as '<adverb-of-its-tier> <pole phrase>'; joined with ', and '; a single non-zero pole renders alone; the all-zero vector renders as no clause at all
